fig-02.purpose: 2x2 scent map placing every ranked fragrance. Placement is Base Note's reading of each brand's official notes, not a measurement.
fig-02.title: Designer cologne scent map: ten picks by their official notes

points.name: Dior Sauvage EDP
points.reason: Calabrian bergamot on top, Sichuan pepper, lavender and star anise in the heart, and Papua New Guinea vanilla extract with ambroxan in the base: a fresh opening balanced by a warm base, so it sits at the centre.

points.name: Acqua di Gio Profondo Parfum
points.reason: Armani describes a deep freshness with a dense, resinous and mineral facet, built on bergamot notes, balsamic cistus absolute and everlasting essence: fresh-leaning, with more weight than a light aquatic.

points.name: YSL Y Intense EDP
points.reason: French blue lavender, crisp sage and fresh geranium intensified with blue juniper berries and patchouli from Bali: aromatic and fresh-leaning, pulled richer by the patchouli.

points.name: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue EDP
points.reason: Seawater cypress with aromatic notes and salty, mineral nuances in a woody aromatic family, described as evoking a sea breeze: the freshest and lightest profile on the list.

points.name: Versace Eros EDP
points.reason: Lemon, mandarin, mint oil and candied apple on top over geranium, clary sage and AmberMax, then cedarwood, vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood and vanilla meeting leather: a fresh top over a sweet woody base, just warm of centre.

points.name: Dolce & Gabbana The One EDP
points.reason: Tarocco blood orange and clary sage over Australian sandalwood, classified Aromatic by Dolce & Gabbana: just fresh of centre and light, softened by sandalwood.

points.name: Givenchy Gentleman EDP
points.reason: Pepper and lavender over orris and Peru balm, with patchouli and black vanilla in a woody floral family that Givenchy also calls balmy: warm and rich.

points.name: Valentino Born in Roma Intense EDP
points.reason: Bourbon vanilla lifted by ginger, lavandin in the heart and smoked vetiver in an ambery fougère, with the vanilla described as unsweetened and leathery: warm, moderately rich, lifted by the lavandin.

points.name: Viktor & Rolf Spicebomb Extreme EDP
points.reason: Black pepper essence, saffron accord and cistus absolute in an ambery spicy family, with lavender, tobacco, bourbon and vanilla in the brand's description: the warmest and richest profile in the guide.

points.name: Prada Paradigme EDP
points.reason: Opens on a smoky blend of Peru balsam, benzoin resin and guaiac wood, with a double geranium extract, Calabrian bergamot and airy musks at the heart: warm and rich, with some lift.
